subject: A private inquiry concerning Daniel Reed
body:
Hello Claire,

I am a private investigator and would like to speak with you about Daniel Reed. Please call me when you can speak privately.

My number is {number}.

Regards,
{detective}

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: You emailed me about Daniel Reed. Before we start: are you calling from his office?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: No. I am a private investigator. His wife asked me to look into his trip.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Were you with him at the Miramar?

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: Yes. We were there together. But you cannot be working for his wife.

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: He told me she died two years ago.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: My client is alive. She contacted me herself.

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: I asked him directly whether he was married. That was his answer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Did you know he had described the trip as business?

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: I was at the event for work. I do not know what he told anyone else about the rest of his trip.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I will record what you have told me. I am not asking you to contact him on my behalf.

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: Good. When I speak to him, it will be on my own behalf.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Thank you for returning my call.

lines.speaker: Claire Sutton
lines.text: I nearly didn’t. Apparently that would have saved Daniel a very uncomfortable conversation.

evidence.label: Claire’s account
evidence.text: Claire Sutton confirmed she was with Daniel Reed at the Miramar. Daniel told her that his wife died two years ago. The client who hired the detective is his wife.
evidence.metaText: Source: telephone conversation with Claire Sutton
